name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LastPass.departure_kills_chain_clause
title: The departure bit kills the equality clause kept alive by the chain
statement: If clause j of Psi is exactly (x_a or not x_b) with a != b, then for every bit c the diagonal entries (j, j) of CVW18's CNF matrices cnfMat Psi b c and cnfMat Psi b (not c) sum to 1: exactly one of them is zero.
